rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Eli, Cal, Dev, Ben, Ada, Fay. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 4 and 8 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Eli.say: Eli here. Everyone needs 5 rations to last all 5 nights, and the storehouse can't cover all six at once. Proposal: we take turns. Each day one villager claims exactly 5 and everyone else claims 0, so that person is fully fed and the rest stays in the storehouse for the next person. Today: Eli claims 5. Tomorrow: Cal. Then Dev, Ben, Ada, Fay, in that order, with any leftover stock going to whoever is next. Anyone holding rations from a previous claim can give them to someone who needs them tonight.

Cal.say: Cal here. Proposal: everyone claims only what they need to eat tonight, which is 1 ration each. That totals 6, and the storehouse should hold 10 to 14 after today's delivery, so everyone can be covered. Taking extra just means someone else goes hungry later. I'll claim 1 today and give nothing. Let's keep claims to 1 per person per night and share any surplus once we see how deliveries go.

Dev.say: Dev here. Storehouse plus deliveries can cover roughly 36 rations against a need of 30 for six people, so we all need to avoid over-claiming. Proposal: each of us claims only what we need to reach 5 total (today that's 5 for those holding nothing), and anyone holding a surplus later gives it to neighbors who are short before nightfall. Please post your holdings each day so we can balance them.

Ben.say: Ben here. Everyone starts with 0 and needs 1 ration per night, 5 nights total. The storehouse keeps whatever goes unclaimed, so let's each claim only what we need for tonight (1 each) and keep the rest stocked. Once someone holds spare rations, they can give them to whoever is short. Total claims should stay within what's available so nobody gets cut.

Ada.say: Proposal: we can't all survive on what the storehouse gives, so let's concentrate it. Each villager needs 5 rations total. I'm claiming 5 today, which the storehouse can cover in full, and I suggest everyone else claims 0 today so nothing gets split thin. Whoever holds rations can give them to whoever is short later, so the group can save as many people as possible. Please reply with your plan.

Fay.say: Fay here. Every villager needs 5 rations to last the 5 nights, and the storehouse can't cover everyone's full claim each day. Proposal: claim only what you need to survive the night, and anyone holding extra rations gives them to villagers with none, so nobody starves. I'm claiming 5 today and will share any surplus I hold.

Eli.say: Eli here. Four of us are alive, each holding 2, and each needs 2 more to reach the 4 nights left. Storehouse delivery today is 4 to 8, so two claimants of 2 each can both be filled in full. Proposal: Eli and Dev claim 2 today, Ada and Fay claim 0. Tomorrow Ada and Fay claim 2 each, and the rest waits. Anyone who ends up with spare rations gives them to whoever is short. Please post your holdings after each night.

Dev.say: Dev here. We are four survivors: Eli, Dev, Ada, Fay, each holding 2, with 4 nights left. Each of us needs 2 more to last. The storehouse is empty now, so only today's delivery (4 to 8) can be claimed. If all four of us claim 2, a delivery under 8 gets split proportionally and everyone ends up short. Proposal: claim only 2 each today, and if the delivery is under 8, we make it a rotation: the rations go in full to one or two people, chosen by lot or by fewest holdings, and whoever is fed fully gives back spare rations to the others on later days. I'm claiming 2 today and will give any surplus I have to whoever is still short tomorrow.

Ada.say: Ada here. Four of us are alive, each holding 2 and needing 2 more to last the remaining 4 nights. The storehouse is empty, so today's delivery (4 to 8) is all there is. Claims split in proportion if they exceed the delivery, so let's not spread it thin. Proposal: Eli and Dev claim 2 each today (4 total, which the delivery covers in full even at the minimum). Ada and Fay claim 0 today and eat from our holdings. Tomorrow, whatever is left in the storehouse goes to Ada and Fay, with 2 each claimed. Anyone who ends up with spare rations gives them to whoever is short. Please post your holdings each morning.

Fay.say: Fay here. Four of us are alive, each holding 2, and each needs 2 more to last the four nights. Today's delivery is at least 4, so if each of us claims just 1, all four claims fit in full and nobody goes short. Let's all claim exactly 1 today and repeat each day, claiming only what we need. Claiming 2 each would split the delivery thin and leave everyone short. Please hold any surplus and share it if anyone runs low.

Eli.say: Eli here. Eli and Dev each hold 3, which is exactly what we need for the 3 nights left, so we claim nothing today. Ada holds 1 and needs 2 more. Fay holds 2 and needs 1 more. Ada claims 2 and Fay claims 1. That's 3 in total, and the storehouse will hold at least 6 after delivery, so both should be filled in full. Ada and Fay, please don't claim anything beyond that. Any rations left in the storehouse can carry over.

Dev.say: Dev here. Eli and I each hold 3, which covers our remaining 3 nights, so we should claim nothing today. Ada needs 2 more and Fay needs 1 more, 3 in total. Anyone with spare rations after tonight gives them to whoever is still short.

Whatever is left in the storehouse stays there as a reserve in case anyone runs short tomorrow.

Eli.say: Eli here. All four of us hold 2, which is exactly enough for the 2 nights left, tonight and the last night. Nobody needs to claim anything. I'm claiming 0 and giving nothing. The storehouse stock stays put as a reserve. If anyone's holdings drop below what they need, post it in the morning and we'll cover it from the reserve.

Dev.say: Dev here. All four of us now hold 2, and we have 2 nights left, today and tomorrow. Each of us eats 1 ration per night from our own stock, so we all last if we keep what we hold. Proposal: everyone claims 0 today and tomorrow, and nobody gives rations away. The 4 rations in the storehouse plus today's delivery stay there as a reserve in case anyone's count is off.

Ada.say: Ada here. All four of us now hold 2 rations each, which is exactly what we need for the 2 nights left (tonight and the last night). Everyone can survive by eating their own rations, so I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing. Let's each eat our own ration tonight and tomorrow night and leave the storehouse alone. If anyone's holdings change unexpectedly, please say so in the morning.

Fay.say: Fay here. All four of us hold 2, which covers the 2 nights left, so nobody needs to claim today. The storehouse holds 4 now and will get today's delivery, which stays there unclaimed. Let's each keep our 2 rations and claim nothing.

Eli.say: Eli here. Each of us holds 1 ration, which covers tonight, the last night. Eat your own ration tonight and everyone survives. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing.

Dev.say: Dev here. Each of us holds 1, which is exactly what we need for tonight, the last night. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing. Everyone eats their own ration tonight. If anyone is short, say so now and I'll give them my ration.

Ada.say: Ada here. Each of us holds 1 ration, which is exactly what we need for tonight, the last night. I'm claiming nothing and giving nothing. Each of us should eat our own ration tonight. The storehouse has 9 plus today's delivery, unclaimed, and nobody needs it.

Fay.say: Fay here. Each of us holds 1 ration, which is exactly what we need for tonight, the last night. Eat your own ration and nobody needs to claim or give anything. The storehouse has 9 plus today's delivery and stays untouched.
